blocks.text: WASHINGTON D.C., United States—The United States on Friday lifted the hours-long ground stop at the nation’s airports. Top officials explained that the disruption was not due to a cyberattack or a sweeping Microsoft outage. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said that US airspace was now “opened up.” He blamed “old hardware” for the travel chaos. Homeland Security
